mailText:
Hi everyone,

we're looking forward to the workshop "{titel}" on {datum} at {uhrzeit} ({ort}).

Please bring a laptop or notebook. If you can't make it, please release your spot via Eventbrite – the waiting list will thank you!

See you soon,
your Community Team

beschreibung.worum: A hands-on session on {thema}. Instead of endless slides, we work on real cases from the room – you bring your project, we bring the methods. Expect a focused, friendly atmosphere where trying things out (and getting them wrong first) is part of the plan.
beschreibung.rahmen: 3-hour workshop in the {ort}, max. {kapazitaet} participants. Laptops welcome, coffee and snacks on the house.
beschreibung.haeufigkeit: Twice a month – usually the 1st Tuesday morning and the 3rd Thursday afternoon.
beschreibung.warum: Many members build something on their own. Our workshops give them a fast, practical boost on {thema} and connect them with peers facing the same questions – so nobody has to figure it out alone.
beschreibung.zielgruppe: Founders, freelancers and intrapreneurs in early stages – members and guests. No prior knowledge of {thema} needed, curiosity is enough.
beschreibung.ergebnis:
• A concrete next step for your own project
• Practical tools and templates on {thema} to take home
• Feedback from peers and new contacts in the community
agenda: Wrap-up: everyone names their next step
beschreibung.tickets: Free for members, €15 for guests. Only {kapazitaet} spots – registration via Eventbrite required. Can't make it? Please release your ticket so someone from the waiting list can join.
beschreibung.betreuung: Lead: {verantwortlich} · On site: Host Team (setup, coffee, check-in) · Facilitation: external trainer (demo)

mailText:
Hi everyone,

it's almost time for "{titel}" on {datum} from {uhrzeit} ({ort}).

Feel free to bring someone who should get to know the community!

See you soon,
your Community Team

beschreibung.worum: An evening to meet the people behind Vienna's impact scene, this time around {thema}. A short welcome, then drinks, snacks and conversations that actually go somewhere – warm, buzzing, zero pressure.
beschreibung.rahmen: Relaxed evening format in the {ort} for around {kapazitaet} guests – standing tables, music in the background, drinks & snacks.
beschreibung.warum: Good collaborations start with a good conversation. We want members to find partners, clients and friends – and newcomers to find their way into the community.
beschreibung.zielgruppe: Members, alumni, partners and newcomers who are curious about the Hub. People who just joined are especially welcome.
beschreibung.ergebnis:
• 3–5 meaningful new contacts
• Knowing who in the community can help with what
• Feeling at home at the Hub
agenda: Short welcome & intro by the hosts
beschreibung.tickets: Free, open to members and guests. Please register via Eventbrite ({kapazitaet} spots) so we can plan drinks and snacks.
beschreibung.betreuung: Lead: {verantwortlich} · On site: Host Team (welcome & bar) and Membership Team (introductions, questions about membership)

mailText:
Hi everyone,

a friendly reminder about the talk "{titel}" on {datum} at {uhrzeit} ({ort}).

Send us your questions in advance – we'll collect them for the discussion.

See you soon,
your Community Team

beschreibung.worum: An inspiring input on {thema}: a guest speaker shares experiences, numbers and honest stories – followed by an open Q&A where the room gets to dig deeper. Thought-provoking, but never dry.
beschreibung.rahmen: Talk in the {ort}: approx. 30 min. input + 30 min. Q&A, seating for {kapazitaet}, drinks afterwards.
beschreibung.warum: We bring fresh perspectives and expert knowledge into the community, spark discussion on {thema} and show what impact looks like in practice.
beschreibung.zielgruppe: Members, guests and partners interested in {thema} and sustainable change – no expert knowledge required.
beschreibung.tickets: Free entry, open to everyone. {kapazitaet} seats – please register via Eventbrite.
beschreibung.betreuung: Lead: {verantwortlich} · On site: Host Team (tech & moderation) · Speaker: external guest (demo)

mailText:
Hi lovely people,

on {datum} at {uhrzeit} it's Wednesday Wrap again – this time "{titel}" ({ort}).

Please sign up quickly so we have enough plates and ideas.

See you Wednesday,
your Community Team

beschreibung.worum: Our Wednesday Wrap: one long table, good food and the people you usually only see behind a laptop – this time around {thema}. Bring your lunch, your news and your questions.
beschreibung.rahmen: Informal lunch in the {ort} for up to {kapazitaet} members – one long table, no slides, no pressure.
beschreibung.haeufigkeit: Monthly – the last Wednesday of the month at lunchtime.
beschreibung.warum: Lunch is where community happens. Members get to know each other beyond the desk, share what they're working on and ask for help.
beschreibung.zielgruppe: All members of the Hub – coworkers, residents and the team. New members are especially encouraged to join.
beschreibung.ergebnis:
• Knowing your coworking neighbours
• Quick help with a current question
• A real lunch break 🙂
agenda: Gather in the kitchen, set the table
Quick round: name & what you're working on
beschreibung.tickets: Members only, free. Bring your own lunch or a dish to share. Sign-up via Eventbrite ({kapazitaet} seats).
beschreibung.betreuung: Lead: {verantwortlich} · On site: Community Lead and Membership Team (hosting the table)

mailText:
Hi everyone,

it's almost time: "{titel}" on {datum} at {uhrzeit} ({ort}).

Doors open 30 minutes earlier. Voting happens on your phone – please bring it charged. 😉

See you soon,
your Community Team

beschreibung.worum: Young impact startups take the stage: 3 minutes each to pitch their idea – this edition: {thema}. Followed by questions and feedback from mentors, investors and the audience. Expect nervous energy, big ideas and a lot of cheering.
beschreibung.rahmen: Evening stage event in the {ort}: 6–8 pitches, a jury of mentors & investors, audience award, {kapazitaet} seats.
beschreibung.haeufigkeit: Quarterly – the last Thursday of each quarter.
beschreibung.warum: We give early-stage founders a stage, honest feedback and access to investors – and show the community what's being built right now.
beschreibung.zielgruppe: On stage: early-stage impact startups. In the audience: members, investors, mentors, partners and everyone curious about new ventures.
beschreibung.ergebnis:
• Founders: feedback, visibility and investor contacts
• Audience: a first look at new ventures and ways to get involved
• Audience award for the favourite pitch
beschreibung.tickets: Free for members and pitching teams, €5 for guests. {kapazitaet} tickets via Eventbrite. Startups apply to pitch via the application form (demo).
beschreibung.betreuung: Lead: {verantwortlich} · On site: Programme Team (startups & jury), Host Team (tech, bar, check-in) · Jury: mentors & investors from the network (demo)
